column1: # Generated-origin metadata was refreshed for #2376 with two TMPDIR lengths and the Clang oracle.
# The vectorized kernels' outputs, a digest per kernel comparison of test-preprocessor and of test-x86-target's
# preprocessor cases (c_preprocessor_test.c, pp_kernel_digest), recorded with BUSTER_PP_RECORD_DIGESTS where the
# scalar twins gave the same outputs (#2924).
# Each line is a key (the comparison's site, '/', the case), a tab and the digest; lines without a tab are comments.
# A digest of '-' matches any: the case's output holds its temporary directory's name, or follows the host's CPU (native).
# The print/ keys are the digest of the text -E prints without line markers (pp_test_printed), recorded where both printers gave it.
